name: Complete Diary Activity Entry Flow
description:
Complete flow:
        1. Click on farm card
        2. Click navigation button
        3. Android back
        4. Verify crop health screen
        5. Click diary icon
        6. Click Add Activity button
        7. Enter activity name "Ram"
        8. Click cost field
        9. Enter cost "10000/-"
        10. Submit
        11. Android back
